steps.npc: I'm one of Trader Stan's crew. We are all part of one of the largest fleet of trading and sailing vessels to ever sail the seas.
If you want to get to a port in a hurry, then you can charter one of our ships to take you there, if the price is right...

steps.player: So, where exactly can I go with your ships?

steps.npc: We run ships all over the place. Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Musa Point and Port Khazard are just a few of our many destinations!

steps.player: If you visit a lot of ports, I take it you have some exotic stuff to trade?

steps.npc: We certainly do! We have access to items bought and sold from around the world. Would you like to take a look? Or would you like to charter a ship?

options.text: Yes, let's see what you're trading.

steps.player: Yes, let's see what you're trading.

options.text: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.
Isn't it tricky to sail about in those clothes?

steps.player: Isn't it tricky to sail about in those clothes?

steps.npc: Tricky? Tricky!
With all due credit, Trader Stan is a great employer, but he insists we wear the latest in high fashion even when sailing.
Do you have even the slightest idea how tricky it is to sail in this stuff?
Some of us tried tearing it and arguing that it was too fragile to wear when on a boat, but he just had it enchanted to re-stitch itself.
It's hard to hate him when we know how much he shells out on this gear, but if I fall overboard because of this getup one more time, I'm going to quit.
Yes... Anyway, would you like to take a look at our exotic wares from around the world? Or would you like to charter a ship?

options.text: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.

steps.player: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.

steps.npc: [Certainly, sir/Certainly, madam/Certainly]. Where would you like to go?

steps.text: If the player does not have the bedsheet in their inventory:
The player is transported to the destination
If the player chooses Crandor during Dragon Slayer I:

steps.npc: Crandor? Are you crazy? No charter ship would take you to that island. You'd need to use your own ship, but even then, you'd need a miracle to find a safe route there!

steps.text: If the player has the bedsheet in their inventory:

steps.npc: Sorry, but we aren't a laundry ship. You'll need to leave those dirty bedsheets behind.

steps.player: Would you let me bring it if I told you it was a security blanket?

steps.npc: No, then we would just mock you.

steps.text: If the player has the ectoplasm covered bedsheet in their inventory:

steps.npc: Is that your bedsheet covered in filthy slime?

steps.player: I can say in all honesty that it is not.

steps.npc: Well, whoever it belongs to, it's not coming on this ship!

steps.text: If the player has Karamjan rum in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'm afraid we can't take you anywhere if you're trying to smuggle that rum.

options.text: What brings you all the way out here?

steps.player: What brings you all the way out here?

steps.npc: The same thing that brings us everywhere, friend. We're here to trade. The tortugans were reluctant at first, but we eventually convinced them to let us do business with them.
It's a shame they won't let us actually go beyond the docks though. I'd quite like to see the rest of their island...
Anyway, would you like to take a look at our exotic wares from around the world? Or would you like to charter a ship?
